answer.what_it_does: CreditAccess Grameen is India's largest NBFC-MFI, empowering women entrepreneurs and low-income households with flexible financial solutions. It offers inclusive group loans, retail finance, micro-insurance, and holistic community support.

segments.name: Group Loans
segments.note: Includes various term loans like IGL, emergency, and sanitation loans

segments.name: Retail Loans
segments.note: Includes unsecured business, Vikas, Unnati, and two-wheeler loans

answer.customers: Women entrepreneurs and low-income households across rural and semi-urban India.

facts.fact: Assets Under Management reached J 295.90 billion with 4.42 million active borrowers.
Operating across 16 states and 1 union territory.
Total CSR spend of J 251.53 million supporting 392,518 beneficiaries.
Maintains 17,727 branch audits performed during the year.

answer.geography: Operates domestically across 16 states and 1 union territory in India, with 87% of the borrower base comprising rural customers.
answer.revenue_mix_basis: Not applicable as single operating segment reported.

risks.risk: Macroeconomic factors leading to higher inflation impacting borrower affordability.
Socio-political developments including localised unrest or election-related disruptions.
Attrition among frontline loan officers impacting productivity and relationship continuity.
Competitive intensity in mature markets and increasing reliance on digital platforms.
